pages.lesson:
LESSON: PROPHECIES ABOUT THE MESSIAH

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Early life of Jesus Christ
Topic 4.1: Prophecies about the Messiah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Prophecies about the Messiah. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How were the Old Testament prophecies about the Messiah fulfilled?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PROPHECIES ABOUT THE MESSIAH
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Prophecies about the Messiah helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: PROPHECIES ABOUT THE MESSIAH
Study Prophecies about the Messiah like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies

What this means
In this part you learn to value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Prophecies about the Messiah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Prophecies about the Messiah is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Prophecies about the Messiah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Prophecies about the Messiah to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Prophecies about the Messiah from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Prophecies about the Messiah: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Prophecies about the Messiah?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How were the Old Testament prophecies about the Messiah fulfilled?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Prophecies about the Messiah means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
